summary: Closure review of prior requested revisions: the manuscript is largely reproducible and the ceiling/null outcome is correctly explained. However two preregistered required clarifications remain unresolved in the submitted manuscript and must be added (both are verifiable from the archived artifacts) before the submission is finalised.
critical_issues: The manuscript does not state the exact discordant pair identifier (pair_id) and the precise archive location or SHA/index of the single repair provider trace inside execution/raw_results.jsonl; without those concrete identifiers an auditor cannot deterministically locate the one repair invocation and verify the discordant episode (this information appears to exist in the archived raw_results and execution manifest).

The manuscript does not explicitly disclose which preregistered secondary estimands/analyses were not executed or archived (e.g., effect_size_Cohen_h_equivalent_for_paired_proportions and any other listed secondary estimands), nor does it state the reason(s) for omission and the interpretive consequences; the analysis artifacts show secondary_results empty but the paper must explicitly report and explain that omission.
required_revisions: Insert the exact discordant pair identifier (pair_id) and the archive locator for the single repair provider trace (either the precise byte/record index in execution/raw_results.jsonl, or the provider-trace artifact path and its SHA256) into the manuscript (Results or Disclosure) and cite the execution_manifest path that cross-references it. This may be copied verbatim from the archived artifacts; do not invent new identifiers.

Add one explicit sentence listing the preregistered secondary estimands that were not executed/archived (by identifier/name), state why they were not executed (e.g., omitted because baseline margin/ceiling made them infeasible or analysis artifacts empty), and note the consequence for interpretation (i.e., these secondary estimands are unavailable/underpowered and thus omitted from confirmatory claims).
optional_revisions: If space permits, include a one-paragraph high-level summary of the single discordant episode’s validator diagnostics (failure mode and what the repair changed) drawn directly from the archived validator trace to illustrate the lone repair’s effect.
Consider moving some long provenance/hash lists into a compact footnote or single provenance paragraph (keeping all artifacts referenced) to improve narrative flow.

Optionally compute and archive the preregistered Cohen‑h equivalent effect-size (or state precisely why the computation was not run) and mention it briefly; this is not required for finalisation but would aid readers.
